Render coordinates are in the reference frame of the SystemBox. Unsure what ignoreStatus does. SPACE_STATUS 19 On rendering hazard environment icons SHIP_STATUS 20 On rendering player element like hull and ressources CHOICE_BOX 21 When any choiceBox related window is on screen TABBED_WINDOW 22 On rendering a tab in the upgrade interface MOUSE_CONTROL 23 Rendering at the highest layer above everything else where the mouse cursor is finally drawn UNKNOWN_MAX 24
